source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Thank you for the feedback!
Our current website for the Bay Area locations, San Francisco CA and Fairfield CA, is [URL_001].
For bookings, WE USE WIX.
We are opening an additional location in Seattle WA, and it will open under the name Smash Room because our brand will be Smash Room from now on. We therefore want [URL_002] to serve as our master site, bringing our brand, locations, and information together in one place. It should include sublinks for each location while enabling every location to track its own bookings, revenue, and sales separately.

value_updates.location_navigation: The master site includes sublinks for each location.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Yes, we can set it up that way. [URL_002] will serve as the master website, where visitors can learn about your brand and select a location. If someone chooses a location such as Seattle or Bay Area, they will be directed to that location's separate Wix website to make bookings and process payments. With this arrangement, every location will have its own Wix account, bookings, calendar, reporting, and payment setup, while remaining connected through the main [URL_002] website.

value_updates.location_navigation: Visitors select a location on the master website.
value_updates.routing_destination: The selected location's separate Wix website.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey! Here is the vision I have for the website.

The objective is to create a national brand website for SMASH ROOM that can accommodate multiple locations and support future franchise growth.

Primary Website:
[URL_006]

I would like a clean, modern, mobile-friendly design with simplicity comparable to iSmashUSA. The branding should use black, purple, and white, with large images, generous spacing, and straightforward navigation.

Sections for the Homepage:

Hero Banner
Location Selector
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
Reviews
FAQ
Contact

The homepage needs to show visitors our offerings right away and let them choose their location.

Locations at Present:

Fairfield, CA
San Francisco, CA
Seattle, WA

Every location should have a dedicated page of its own, while the design and branding remain consistent across all locations.

The site should be structured so that future locations can be added easily without requiring a redesign.

Possible future examples:

Phoenix
Denver
Austin
Franchise Locations

Overall, it should feel like a national entertainment brand rather than a local business website.

value_updates.location_navigation: A location selector on the master homepage lets visitors choose their location.
